views.name: track_durations
views.body_sql:
SELECT "TrackId" AS track_id, "Milliseconds" / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes
FROM "Track"
views.description: one row per track with duration converted to minutes

views.name: classified_tracks
views.body_sql: SELECT td.track_id, td.duration_minutes, CASE WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT MIN(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Short' WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT AVG(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Medium' WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT MAX(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Very Long' END AS category FROM track_durations td
views.description: one row per track with category assigned based on global minimum, average, and maximum duration thresholds
